Settings panel."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"A long unattended run should not die because one request hit a transient network
error. This plugin "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"keeps such a request retrying — exponential backoff, with a
delay ceiling — until it succeeds or you"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"h a request retrying — exponential backoff, with a
delay ceiling — until it succeeds or you stop it."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Standard DSH bundle plugin, one-command install. **The same package supports both
the DSH Web UI and"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" the official desktop client (Electron).**"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Figures above are sample data. The layout, copy, and controls are the plugin's own."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Where to install it"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"This repository maintains one product line (`main`). The same package supports
both surfaces."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Surface | Install |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| **DSH Web UI** | Open the **Plugins** page, click **Add plugin**, and enter `dsh-unlimited-retry` "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"— or run `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-unlimited-retry` in a terminal |
| **Official desktop cli"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ent (Electron)** | Open the **Plugins** page, click **Add plugin**, and enter `dsh-unlimited-retry` "},{"id":"p11s4","text":"nt (Electron)** | Open the **Plugins** page, click **Add plugin**, and enter `dsh-unlimited-retry` |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Installing from the UI"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Both surfaces ship the plugin manager, so the shortest path is the same:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"1. Open **Plugins** in the app.
2. Click **Add plugin**.
3. Enter `dsh-unlimited-retry` (or `dsh-unl"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"imited-retry@<version>` to pin one).
4. Confirm, then reopen the app or reload the page if the Setti"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ngs page does not
appear immediately."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The dialog accepts npm packages, Git repositories, and local directories, so the
same box also takes"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" `github:xalor888/dsh-unlimited-retry` or a `link:` path."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Why the desktop must not use `dsh plugin --profile desktop`"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"The desktop client reads a profile named `desktop`, which is reserved for the
Electron application —"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" the CLI refuses to touch it on purpose:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"A `--profile web` install therefore lands in the `web` profile, while the desktop
window reads `desk"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"top`, so nothing appears. The UI path above is scoped to
whichever profile the running app actually "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"owns, which is why it is the one to
use."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"> Why the desktop works: the desktop profile *is* the Web template (`base` +
> `web-app`), and Elect"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ron loads the local Web UI URL. The `dsh.client` panel is
> therefore loaded by `client-modules` the"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"re too — no separate client build.
>
> The `dsh web` command line uses its own `web` profile: restar"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"t the host after an
> update, then hard-reload the browser (`Ctrl+F5`, or `Cmd+Shift+R` on macOS) to"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"
> bypass the cache."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Why a separate plugin"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"DSH ships `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-retry`, but it only *executes* retries — the
budget lives on each pr"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ovider adapter's `retryPolicy`. Its default
`mode: "normal"` gives up after `maxRetries` (5 in this "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"build) and then
delegates, so the step fails, the turn closes with an error, and the run ends.
`mode"},{"id":"p22s4","text":": "always"` exists but is all-or-nothing per provider and has no delay
ceiling."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"This plugin adds a layer *behind* all of them. `agent/request-error` is a
waterfall event and Cordis"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" runs listeners outermost-first, so the
**last-registered listener is the deepest**: every other rec"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"overy gets the first
word, and only a failure that nobody recovered reaches this plugin."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Defaults, and what they cost"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"**No configured failure code is terminal by default — including auth, quota,
billing, and context-ov"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"erflow codes.** That is what *unlimited* means here, and
it is announced once at mount so it is a vi"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"sible decision rather than a silent
spend. The only bound is `maxDelayMs`, so a permanently failing "},{"id":"p27s4","text":"request costs
roughly one request per minute, forever."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Two ways to bound it:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"1. **Set `maxAttempts`** to a positive integer — this plugin then stops after
that many tries per st"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ep and delegates, exactly as if it were not installed.
2. **List terminal codes in `excludeCodes`.**"},{"id":"p29s3","text":" The panel has a one-click
*Use recommended set* action for the codes where a retry re-sends a reque"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"st
that fails identically:"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"`AUTH`, `UNAUTHORIZED`, `FORBIDDEN`, `BILLING`, `QUOTA`, `ACCOUNT_QUOTA`,
`MISSING_CREDENTIAL`, `INV"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"ALID_CREDENTIAL`, `MODEL_NOT_FOUND`, `NO_ADAPTER`,
`CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`, `CONTEXT_OVERFLOW`, `C"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"ONTEXT_LENGTH`,
`INVALID_REQUEST`"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"> `IMAGE_OFFLOAD_REQUIRED` is **deliberately absent**: `dsh-compaction-image-offload`
> recovers it "},{"id":"p31s2","text":"by shrinking the request and registers ahead of this plugin. If
> it declines, retrying is the corre"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"the request and registers ahead of this plugin. If
> it declines, retrying is the correct next move."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"A cleared numeric field **falls back to its default** rather than being read as
zero — `Number(null)"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"` is `0`, which for a delay is a busy loop and for jitter is
no jitter at all."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"| Requirement | Value |"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"| Node.js | **>= 20** |
| DSH | **>= 0.2.0-0 < 0.3.0-0** (`engines.dsh`, enforced by the host's comp"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"atibility preflight). Verified against 0.2.1-rc.3, 0.2.1-rc.5, 0.2.2-alpha.2 and 0.2.2-rc.1 |
| Ship"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"s `dsh-agent-loop` and `dsh-llm-retry` | Yes — the retry listener hangs off that event |"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"The session-projection reader adapts to both registration shapes the Host has
shipped: the disposer "},{"id":"p36s2","text":"returned before 0.2.2, and the callable thenable returned
from 0.2.2 on, whose `typeof` is `"functio"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"n"` while it still carries `then`.
The handle is preferred where it exists, so no deprecated read is"},{"id":"p36s4","text":" performed on a
runtime that deprecated it."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"The `-0` lower bound in `engines.dsh` is deliberate: the host matches with
`includePrerelease: true`"},{"id":"p37s2","text":", and only a boundary carrying a prerelease tag admits a
prerelease runtime such as `0.2.1-rc.3`. A "},{"id":"p37s3","text":"plain `>=0.2.0` would silently exclude
every `-rc` build.
- `AbortSignal.any` is used when present; "},{"id":"p37s4","text":"a controller-based fallback covers runtimes without it.
- A 1.x `config` still mounts: `retryAllCode"},{"id":"p37s5","text":"s` is ignored and `terminalCodes` is read as `excludeCodes`, each with a one-line warning naming the"},{"id":"p37s6","text":" replacement.
- The Web panel additionally needs `configEditor` and the `settings.section` slot. Wit"},{"id":"p37s7","text":"hout them the policy still applies; the page is simply absent or read-only."}],"truncated":true}
